profile.headline: Software Developer at Marex
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Lead contributor to the front end development of a .NET Core web application used for transaction services and money
movement for millions of daily transactions, improving security and application performance (.NET, Angular, SQL)
●
Build new backend application architecture to handle the migration of all transactional data from a database to an API
solution
o Created new REST API in .NET Core (backend development) to process new data from partner banks and display
in an existing application
●
Personally oversee regular releases and ensure minimal downtime to 10,000+ users (CI/CD, Jenkins/Jules, Git)
o Collaborated with business stakeholders to deliver feature enhancements
o Adapted systems to support evolving partner application requirements.
●
Act as application support and remediate production issues for users regularly

positions.title: Developer/ IT Supoort
positions.description:
Built and maintained a web API to process medical data from a consultant and update our recruiting system. 
Lead the implementation of software allowing panelists to be onboarded remotely
Made improvements to the recruiting database application

positions.title: Information Technology Support Specialist
positions.description: Developed internal use software to help assist in the implementation of the ClinCard payment system. Lead team to assist in the development and implementation of a HIPPA compliant online sign-up process for panelists. Performed web development tasks regarding maintaining, updating, and adding features to the company website. Answered employee inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems. I still occasionally assist them remotely

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description: Protect and supervise people at the beach. Perform some maintenance tasks.
